name: Azra Haunted House Chamber of Horrors
tagline: Azra presents a new haunted house option – The Oakland Press
description: Azra Haunted House Chamber of Horrors is an agritourism farm in 31401 John R Rd bldg 2, MI, open to visitors for seasonal picking and farm activities. Offerings follow the growing season, so what is available changes through the year. Check the website for current hours and availability.
